keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Southampton 1, Queens Park Rangers 0. Kuryu Matsuki (Southampton) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Southampton 2, Queens Park Rangers 0. Cameron Bragg (Southampton) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Ryan Manning.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Karamoko Dembélé replaces Kwame Poku.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Koki Saito replaces Harvey Vale.

Goal! Southampton 3, Queens Park Rangers 0. Keven Schlotterbeck (Southampton) header from the left side of the six yard box to the top left corner. Assisted by Ryan Manning with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Southampton 3, Queens Park Rangers 1. Richard Kone (Queens Park Rangers) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Karamoko Dembélé.
Jonathan Varane (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Southampton. Flynn Downes replaces James Ward-Prowse.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Alfie Lloyd replaces Paul Smyth.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Dennis Cirkin replaces Boy Kemper.
Kealey Adamson (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Jimmy Dunne (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Southampton. Samuel Edozie replaces Kuryu Matsuki.
Substitution, Southampton. Divin Mubama replaces Lewis Dobbin.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Ilias Chair replaces Glen Kamara.
Delay in match because of an injury Alfie Lloyd (Queens Park Rangers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Southampton. Barnaby Williams replaces Cameron Bragg.
Substitution, Southampton. Welington replaces Ryan Manning.
Goal! Southampton 4, Queens Park Rangers 1. Welington (Southampton) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Second Half ends, Southampton 4, Queens Park Rangers 1.
